title: Learned event-center projected trace-commit graph capacity
purpose: Test whether a causal LiDAR prediction of the junction or terminal center reduces duplicate topological nodes before unchanged learned association and execution-trace commit.

worlds.fit_and_method_selection: 60 procedural worlds: topology families S01-S10, replicates C01-C06
worlds.development_validation: 20 disjoint procedural worlds: topology families S01-S10, replicates C07-C08
worlds.forbidden: C09, C10, strict test and all M-TARE benchmark worlds

sampling.independent_unit: procedural world; physical support unit is a directed traversal
sampling.temporal_context: current plus four strictly past observations in the same traversal

student_inputs: three frozen causal action-set model contexts
predicted signed event-center offset along the executed traversal tangent
three frozen learned association models and learned exit tokens
executed traversal identity and causal within-world order
split_logic: C01-C06 choose one already registered proposal threshold; the frozen method is applied once to C07-C08. No C07-C08 result may change model, association threshold, 4 m cap or commit rule.

methods.main: Project each event hypothesis from sensor pose by the three-seed learned signed center offset, then apply the frozen factorized association and require two independent traversals before node commit; edges require a completed physical trace.
methods.baselines: The sealed sensor-pose trace-commit graph, immediate learned-ghost commit and fixed structured-rule trace commit.
methods.fallback: None inside this run. Scientific failure stops the scalar center-projection mechanism.

metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.node: precision >=0.98, false loop merge <=0.01 and recall >=0.25
metrics_and_pre_registered_gates.improvement: node-edge macro-F1 improves the stronger immediate-ghost or structured-rule baseline by >=0.05

retention: Retain projection archive, graph nodes, graph edges, decision trace, pair scores, metrics, logs and SHA-256 seal; no LiDAR payload is duplicated.

approval.scope: One immutable C01-C08 projected trace-commit audit; zero training and zero C09/C10/M-TARE.
approval.confirmation_reference: User instructed automatic best-choice execution without further routine approval prompts.
